_note: SRD 5.2 spells (CC-BY-4.0) the game implements so far: numbers from the SRD, summaries in our own words. Ranges and areas in feet. Only Cleric and Wizard can cast yet (DND-23); Paladin and Ranger spells follow as data. effect.kind: attack | save | missiles | heal | buff | stabilize | teleport | ward | temp-hp. where: combat | any (also outside fights) | rest (outside fights only).

sacred-flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred-flame.summary: Radiant flame strikes a creature within 60 ft: Dexterity save or 1d8 radiant damage.

spare-the-dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare-the-dying.summary: A dying ally within 15 ft (30 ft from level 5) becomes Stable.

fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire-bolt.summary: Ranged spell attack, 120 ft: 1d10 fire damage.

ray-of-frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray-of-frost.summary: Ranged spell attack, 60 ft: 1d8 cold damage and the target's Speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn.

chill-touch.name: Chill Touch
chill-touch.summary: Melee spell attack: 1d10 necrotic damage; the target can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

shocking-grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking-grasp.summary: Melee spell attack: 1d8 lightning damage (it also stops Opportunity Attacks, which the game doesn't have yet).

acid-splash.name: Acid Splash
acid-splash.summary: An acid bubble bursts at a point within 60 ft: everyone within 5 ft of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid.

poison-spray.name: Poison Spray
poison-spray.summary: Ranged spell attack, 30 ft: 1d12 poison damage.

bless.name: Bless
bless.summary: Up to three allies within 30 ft add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws (concentration, 1 minute). One more ally per slot level above 1.

cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure-wounds.summary: Touch: an ally regains 2d8 + your Wisdom modifier hit points (+2d8 per slot level above 1).

guiding-bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding-bolt.summary: Ranged spell attack, 120 ft: 4d6 radiant, and the next attack against the target before your next turn ends has Advantage.

healing-word.name: Healing Word
healing-word.summary: Bonus Action, 60 ft: an ally regains 2d4 + your Wisdom modifier hit points (+2d4 per slot level above 1).

inflict-wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict-wounds.summary: Touch: Constitution save, 2d10 necrotic damage (half on a success; +1d10 per slot level above 1).

shield-of-faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield-of-faith.summary: Bonus Action, 60 ft: an ally gets +2 AC (concentration, 10 minutes).

prayer-of-healing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayer-of-healing.summary: 10 minutes, outside fights: up to five allies gain the benefits of a Short Rest and regain 2d8 hit points. Each can benefit once per Long Rest.

mass-healing-word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass-healing-word.summary: Bonus Action, 60 ft: up to six allies each regain 2d4 + your Wisdom modifier hit points.

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands
burning-hands.summary: A 15-ft cone of flame: Dexterity save, 3d6 fire damage (half on a success). Allies in the cone are hit too.

color-spray.name: Color Spray
color-spray.summary: A 15-ft cone of dazzling light: Constitution save or Blinded until the end of your next turn.

false-life.name: False Life
false-life.summary: You gain 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points (+5 per slot level above 1). They last until used up or a Long Rest.

ice-knife.name: Ice Knife
ice-knife.summary: Ranged spell attack, 60 ft: 1d10 piercing; hit or miss, the shard bursts — the target and everyone within 5 ft make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 cold.

mage-armor.name: Mage Armor
mage-armor.summary: Touch an ally wearing no armor: their base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours.

magic-missile.name: Magic Missile
magic-missile.summary: Three darts that never miss, 120 ft: 1d4 + 1 force each, at one target or several (+1 dart per slot level above 1).

ray-of-sickness.name: Ray of Sickness
ray-of-sickness.summary: Ranged spell attack, 60 ft: 2d8 poison, and the target is Poisoned (Disadvantage on attacks) until the end of your next turn.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.summary: A 15-ft cube of thunder from you: Constitution save, 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft away (half damage and no push on a success).

misty-step.name: Misty Step
misty-step.summary: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to an empty square.

scorching-ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching-ray.summary: Three rays, 120 ft: a ranged spell attack each for 2d6 fire, at one target or several (+1 ray per slot level above 2).

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.summary: A burst of sound at a point within 60 ft: everyone within 10 ft makes a Constitution save, 3d8 thunder (half on a success).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.summary: An explosion at a point within 150 ft: everyone within 20 ft makes a Dexterity save, 8d6 fire (half on a success). Mind your friends.

lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning-bolt.summary: A 100-ft line of lightning from you: Dexterity save, 8d6 lightning (half on a success).
